title: Force Speed
text: Attack with a unit. For this attack, it gains: “On Attack: Return any number of non-<uq> (non-unique) upgrades attached to the defender to their owners' hands.”
rules:
If you play Forse Speed, you must attack with a unit, if able. Units must be ready in order to attack.
(ERRATA) Templating update: “Defender” becomes “defending unit”.
